biotools.summary: NP3 MS Workflow is an open-source software system designed for LC-MS/MS untargeted metabolomic data processing and analysis, aimed at ranking bioactive natural products directly from complex mixtures. It allows for customization and diagnostic statistics to optimize data processing and integrates tools for ion deconvolution, structural annotation, and quantification.
